# Dinesh Kumar

> Personal portfolio of Merugu Dinesh Kumar, an MCA student and frontend developer.

## About

I build frontend websites and practical software projects. My interests include responsive web interfaces, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, automation, and AI-assisted development with human review.

## Selected projects

- [IMPERIUM](https://dineshmerugu06.github.io/Dinesh_1/my-skills/projects/imperium/): multi-agent AI project exploring task delegation and career-focused workflows.
- [KeyMind](https://dineshmerugu06.github.io/Dinesh_1/my-skills/projects/keymind/): Python and Selenium password-update automation project.
- [Auction Space](https://dineshmerugu06.github.io/Dinesh_1/my-skills/projects/auction-space/): web-based auction concept.
- [College Bus Tracking](https://dineshmerugu06.github.io/Dinesh_1/my-skills/projects/college-bus-tracking/): college transport tracking concept.
- [Sreeka Interiors](https://sreeka-interiors.vercel.app): interior design website.
